outDir.description: Directory to write downloaded transcripts to. Relative paths resolve from cwd.

userId.description: Default meeting organizer's user ID or UPN, used when a tool/command call omits userId.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. 'Asia/Bangkok') used for day boundaries (today/yesterday) and displayed meeting times in the sync report. Defaults to the system timezone.

weekly.description: Directory to write /teams-transcript-weekly reports to, one file per ISO week (e.g. 2026-W32.md, matching Obsidian periodic-note naming). Relative paths resolve from cwd. Required for that command — no default.

projects.description: Root of a project-notes tree (e.g. an Obsidian vault Projects folder) — subfolders are scanned recursively, one .md per project. When set, /teams-transcript-summarize and /teams-transcript-weekly cross-link meeting notes with matching project notes, creating or updating a project note when a discussed project has none yet. Relative paths resolve from cwd. Optional — feature is skipped entirely when unset.

vaultMeetings.description: Vault directory /teams-transcript-push copies meeting .md notes into (e.g. an Obsidian vault Meetings folder). Relative paths resolve from cwd.
